trigger_condition.value_trigger: floating point values where rounding error is detectable
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Apply softmax before and after an inverse permute/transpose on the same floating-point tensor and compare outputs.

bug_oracle.description: Softmax outputs before and after inverse permutation differ by a small floating-point amount.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Randomly generate floating-point tensors and apply permute or transpose operations to create layout variations.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Use float32 and float64 tensors with values likely to expose rounding differences, such as large dynamic range or negative values.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Keep the same logical reduction dimension and dtype across permuted softmax variants.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Compare softmax(dim=d) followed by inverse permute/transpose versus permute/transpose followed by softmax(dim=0).
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compute max absolute difference between the two outputs and flag any non-zero difference or difference above a strict tolerance.
